planets.name: TOI-1472 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1472 with a 15.5-day year, found in 2025.

text.card: TOI-1472 c was found in 2025 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around TOI-1472. Its orbit and size follow Carleo et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
